"""Collect-only of nightly.sh's serial phase form (every serial-only entry, GIVEN set, the close's plugin).

    python3 -I nightly_serial_collect.py <tree>

Runs nothing but collection; prints the exit code, the W2-13 lines collected and the run's tail.
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "src"))
from gov.close.pytest_plugin.gov_close_serial_only import entries  # noqa: E402

ents = entries(root)
plug = root / "src" / "gov" / "close" / "pytest_plugin"
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if k not in ("PYTEST_ADDOPTS", "PYTEST_PLUGINS")}
env.update({"PYTHONPATH": f"{root / 'src'}{os.pathsep}{plug}", "GOV_CLOSE_SERIAL_ONLY_OF": str(root),
            "GOV_CLOSE_SERIAL_ONLY_GIVEN": "\n".join(ents), "PYTEST_XDIST_AUTO_NUM_WORKERS": "1"})
cmd = [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", *ents, "--collect-only", "-q", "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "--no-header",
       "-p", "gov_close_serial_only"]
done = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=str(root), env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                      timeout=900)
print("optin:", repr(os.environ.get("GOV_TESTS_OPTIN")), "exit:", done.returncode, "entries given:", len(ents))
lines = done.stdout.splitlines()
print("W2-13 collected:")
print("\n".join(line for line in lines if "W2-13" in line) or "  (none)")
print("tail of stdout:")
print("\n".join(lines[-3:]))
print("stderr:")
print(done.stderr.strip()[-1500:])
